explanation: The image-to-video approach, matching start/end pictures, fixed-camera instructions and audio removal were appropriate. The chain lacked exact-duration finishing, allowing a requested six-second generation to be delivered at 6.6 seconds; any correction must preserve the loop endpoint rather than simply cut it off. The grader’s inability to verify silence or looping from still frames is not evidence that those requirements failed.
better_chain: image (make the calm 16:9 lake scene) → image-to-video (animate subtle ripples for 6 seconds, matching start/end pictures, fixed camera, discard audio) → assemble (fit the complete loop to exactly 6 seconds without losing either endpoint, silent 16:9 output) → gate (verify duration, absent audio, visible ripples and repeated end-to-start playback)

steps.issue: Appropriate starting image, aspect and composition; no designed lettering was needed.
Correct tool, matching endpoint inputs, six-second setting and explicit fixed-camera, subtle-motion and audio-discard instructions.

missing: Exact-duration finishing that preserves the complete loop, followed by verification of the final file’s duration, audio absence and end-to-start continuity.
